climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Pinot Gris, Riesling, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Gewürztraminer fully without cooking off their freshness.
Riesling, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

soil.rock: Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.
